cohort: 50 patients with Kawasaki disease and 200 age- and gender-matched control subjects
finding: Previous antibiotic administration was significantly associated with Kawasaki disease, particularly in infants under 12 months of age, suggesting a potential link between antibiotic use, gut microbiota, and the development of Kawasaki disease.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was identified as an associated factor in addition to previous antibiotic administration in infants under 12 months of age, but not in older children.
